_doc: Named pose sets and the motion checks' tables (checks/core.py pose_set, modules/range_sweep.py, collision_sweep.py, clearance.py, fit.py). No joint range lives here: every range end comes from the joint ranges the body definitions declare (`joints:` of robot/**/<builder>.bom.yaml, robot/body/bom/bom_config.py; core.declare_ranges). What stays here is which joints and combinations to pose, and the stress poses that go deliberately beyond a declared range (the A-11 / A-12 leg library, stress_ends, the fit sweeps' beyond_deg and combined poses); the checks measure those and report them apart (beyond_declared_range), never in the design-pose results. Sources: leg_motion (robot/body/hip-shell/sections/leg_motion.py: KEY poses, realistic library, range GRID, each a (pitch, roll, yaw, knee) tuple driving the joints of leg_motion.joints), fit_poses (the exact-fit list; fit_extremes = its last N poses), range_ends.joints = each listed joint alone at both ends of its declared range, stress_ends = single joints at a deliberate angle (deg). These sources name the joints of one leg; a scope on the other leg gets them mirrored onto the mirror joints (checks.relations.joint_mirrors: origin and axis mirrored at the mirror plane, angle x sign), a scope on both gets both. Joint and link names here are configuration: the code reads no meaning from them.

key._doc: stress_ends: the A-12 target extremes beyond the declared ranges (hip pitch -90 vs -58, roll -45 vs -30, yaw +-40 vs +-30, knee 125 vs 95), measured and reported apart (beyond_declared_range). The old hand-copied end list also held hip pitch +40, inside the declared range, now replaced by its declared end +45.

leg_motion._doc: The joints leg_motion's (pitch, roll, yaw, knee) tuples drive, in that order.

joint_mirrors._doc: Mirror joints declared where the joint table does not give them (checks.relations.joint_mirrors finds the joint whose origin and axis mirror a joint's within 1 mm): {joint: [mirror joint, angle sign]}, used both ways by the motion checks (core.joint_mirrors). L_ankle_roll's manifest origin (y -19.0) is 5.5 mm off the mirror of R_ankle_roll's (y -13.5).

fit_poses._doc: The exact-fit pose list (fit_check_upper_hip.py's list plus the hip-shell target extremes; roll_flip_checks.fit_poses() reads it): standing; then each sweep's joint alone at the multiples of step_deg inside its declared range (0 left out) and at both declared ends, then at beyond_deg (deliberate stress angles outside the declared range: the knee to 105-125, hip yaw to +-35 / 40, pitch to -90, roll to -45; reported apart); pose name = name formatted with deg; then the combined poses in order (as data: the ones beyond a declared range are reported apart).

joint_sweep_wide_deg._doc: Stress extent range_sweep turns each joint over (deg): what the training tape asks for, with margin; deliberately beyond the declared range, whose angles the sweep marks and reports apart (beyond_declared_range). Keyed by full joint name; a joint not listed takes its mirror joint's entry (checks.relations.joint_mirrors, angles x sign), else its declared range widened by _margin_deg on each side; the swept range always covers the declared range (a declared range wider than its entry widens the sweep). A joint without a declared range is not swept.

own_servo._doc: range_sweep's joint's own servo (case, horn, idler), whose contacts with each other are a servo-model contact reported apart: the servo_case parts (role class, data/roles.json) on the joint's parent or child link whose box holds the joint origin, and the servo_output parts on those links that the joint axis passes through within such a case's extent along the axis; boxes widened by tol_mm. A part's body definition may declare it: spec.servo_of_joint names the joint.

screening_solids._doc: Which parts are screened with their native STEP when they are not in scope (a scoped part always is, checks/core.py screen_solid): kind in step_kinds or role class in step_classes, not in except_classes (role classes and kinds: data/roles.json, a definition's kind wins). The STEP's solids under min_solid_mm3 are left out (a servo's housing without its internal gears): the part's exact_fit.min_solid_mm3 (body definition), else class_min_solid_mm3 of its role class, else 0; when that leaves a solid that does not span the part's box, every solid is taken.

region_poses._doc: Pose lists for parts on the arm, neck and torso links. Every angle is an end of the joint's declared range (body definitions `joints:`, core.declare_ranges): `ends` = each joint alone at both ends; `combinations` = joints together at the named end (lo / hi; `name` optional); `corners` (library and all only) = every combination of ends of the listed groups, the joints of one group taking the same end. A scope part whose owning link is in a region's links gets that region's poses instead of the leg-motion set: key = standing + ends + combinations; library and all add the corners; fit = key. A joint the body lacks is left out of a pose; a pose naming a joint without a declared range is left out and the joint listed (joints_without_range). Change a range in its definition, never here.

controller_limit_corners._doc: Owner decision D-15 (robot/body/hip-shell/DECISIONS.md, A-12): a contact at a pose where every joint of one group stands at (or past) an end of its declared range (body definitions `joints:`) at once is a controller self-collision limit, not a design target. clearance and collision_sweep still measure such poses but report their contacts apart (controller_limit_contacts), never as design overlaps. groups: lists of full joint names of one side; the group of their mirror joints (checks.relations.joint_mirrors) counts too. end_tol_deg: how close to a range end counts as at the end (a pose past the end counts too).
